output: Catalogued finite neighbour counting on the actual handoff pattern. Every source demand is a selected excess port; high-centre normal form makes its terminal degree three, and fixed-terminal demands inject into that terminal's neighbour set. Thus each demand-terminal fibre has size at most three. Matching or star source edges can each be assigned a distinct demand before terminal projection, yielding a candidate at-most-three source-edge terminal fibre and excluding the all-root configuration once the registered pattern size is at least three. This is a candidate mechanism; its complete structural payoff and implementation are separate gates.
